design: INDIVIDUAL 08: a slim very old councillor with a slightly stooped back, pale weathered mottled skin, broad flat skull, widely separated four mouth mandibles and thick long silver tendrils parted into two tails. A deep aubergine robe with an oversized soft cowl resting behind the neck, bronze-bordered sleeves and three short embroidered cloth panels. Both hands open at waist level in a conciliatory gesture, no handheld object; small rectangular teal council docket in a side case.
